values.note: DCR shuts the water off for the season in late October (2026: from October 19), after which there are no water hookups or dump station; the B Street bathhouse stays open.

values.note: ReserveAmerica sells 405 electric sites (357 Standard Electric, 48 RV/Trailer Electric) and 44 tent or popup sites; 165 take 40 ft, 155 take 35 ft and 84 take 25 ft, so nearly all fit a 23-ft motorhome. All back-in, and DCR notes 'there is no shade over the sites'.

Fees (manual 2026-09-20, not overwritten) - proposed fees.note: "MA DCR publishes this campground's rate by name: $22 a night for a Massachusetts resident, $70 for everyone else, plus $4 water and $6 electric 'at all sites' and a $3 surcharge 'to benefit the Salisbury Beach Trust Fund' that every camper pays (ReserveAmerica, read 2026-10-28). Since every RV site has both hookups, a resident's night is $35 and a non-resident's $83. Add $4.50 per reservation (not per night); no entrance fee for campers." The $3 trust surcharge is a mandatory per-night charge and could also go in surcharges as {"trust": 3}.
